description: UTILITIESCOMMUNICATION_cell_tower is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. This feature class represents cell tower locations in the City of Austin and surrounding counties. Coverage: Austin. Its tags are agoltosocrata. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2025-10-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
